name: Poll
what: A social poll: the card pops, the question and the answers come in, a tap picks one with a ripple, then every answer's bar fills to its share with the percent counting - the tapped one ticked, the winner in the accent colour.
origin: polls and quizzes in social media packs - the template kinds marketplaces list (Mixkit, Envato Elements, Motion Array, Videohive), researched 2026-10-16
motion: card back.out 14 f; answers 12 f, 4 f apart; the tap 8 f, a 3 f press, ripple 14 f; bars fill 24 f (slow end) with the counts; the winner kicks
